facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts that US adults will spend 20% of their entire media time watching CTV by 2026.
facts.quote: EMARKETER forecasting that US adults will spend 20% of their entire media time watching CTV by 2026.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its platform gives access to CTV plus other channels such as native, display, and video, on smartphones, tablets, and computers, so marketers can deliver a consistent brand experience across screens.
facts.quote: This allows marketers to deliver a seamless brand experience across multiple screens, ensuring consistent messaging and better engagement throughout the customer journey.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends that CTV retargeting creatives match in look and feel across all ads so they reinforce brand identity and create a cohesive user experience.
facts.quote: you want to ensure that they match the look and feel of one another. This will help reinforce brand identity and create a cohesive user experience.

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises against layering overly restrictive targeting criteria on CTV retargeting campaigns because it can limit scale, and recommends going broad on inventory and device types instead.
facts.quote: instead of layering on overly restrictive targeting criteria, which can limit your scale, go broad with your choice of inventory and device types for your retargeting campaign

facts.fact: StackAdapt says marketers should work with technology partners to track the full customer journey, from a user seeing a CTV ad through site visit, follow-up messaging, and conversion, to measure multi-touch effectiveness.
facts.quote: track the entire customer journey—from the moment a user sees a CTV ad to when they visit a site, engage with follow-up messaging, and ultimately convert
